en.headline: International Lantern Spectacular opens at Victoria Park from Thursday
en.dek: The Hong Kong Tourism Board’s inaugural free event runs 17 to 27 September, featuring lanterns from 20 countries and giant Nanjing Qinhuai works including an eight-metre banyan installation.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board will open its first International Lantern Spectacular at Victoria Park on Thursday, running until 27 September under the theme of reunion. The free event sits alongside the Leisure and Cultural Services Department’s Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival at the same park.

Highlights include the World Lantern Boulevard with more than 3,000 lanterns from 20 countries and regions, and four giant Nanjing Qinhuai lanterns recognised as national intangible cultural heritage. The centrepiece, Shadowlight, is an eight-metre banyan-tree installation at the main entrance, crafted by Nanjing artisans.

Lanterns will be lit daily from 6.30pm to 11pm, extended to midnight on Mid-Autumn Festival on 25 September. From 17 to 20 September, mooncake stalls organised with Po Leung Kuk will offer regional varieties at the South Pavilion Plaza, with proceeds going to charity. Visitors can also see locally handcrafted Hong Kong lanterns at the Hill Knoll Pavilion.

zh.headline: 國際中秋綵燈匯周四起在維園亮燈
zh.dek: 香港旅遊發展局首辦免費活動由9月17日至27日舉行，展出20個國家地區綵燈及南京秦淮巨型作品，包括八米高榕樹裝置。
body: 香港旅遊發展局將於周四起在維多利亞公園舉行首屆國際中秋綵燈匯，活動至9月27日結束，主題為團圓，並與康樂及文化事務署同場的中秋綵燈會同期舉行，免費入場。
亮點包括匯聚逾3,000盞來自20個國家及地區綵燈的世界綵燈大道，以及四組被列為國家非物質文化遺產的南京秦淮巨型綵燈。主打作品「影光」是一座高八米的榕樹裝置，由南京工匠製作，位於公園正門。
綵燈每晚6時30分至11時亮燈，中秋正日9月25日延長至午夜12時。9月17日至20日，旅發局與保良局合作在南亭廣場設月餅攤位，售賣上海、雲南及潮州等地月餅，收益撥作慈善。訪客亦可在Hill Knoll Pavilion欣賞逾400盞本地手紮綵燈。
